summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total building permits and total housing starts for August 2022 and the revised July 2022 figures. Total permits SAAR decreased from 1,685,000 (July) to 1,517,000 (August), a 10.0% drop, satisfying the task's condition for August 2022. Corresponding housing starts SAAR increased from 1,404,000 to 1,575,000 (12.2% change). This document covers the beginning of the required 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe and supplies the specific permit decrease and associated start values for August 2022 needed for the average change calculation.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release (Report CB22-174, released October 19, 2022) on New Residential Construction for September 2022. Relevant to the task: It provides the specific Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for Total Building Permits and Total Housing Starts for August and September 2022, covering the initial segment of the required 2022/08–2025/05 period. The document confirms that while Total Permits decreased from July to August 2022 (1,685,000 to 1,542,000)—making August a qualifying month—it also shows Total Permits increased from August to September 2022 (1,542,000 to 1,564,000), excluding September from the "decrease" condition. It supplies the corresponding Total Starts SAAR for the qualifying August 2022 period (July: 1,377,000 to August: 1,566,000). Crucially, the data for August 2022 is marked as revised ('r'), ensuring this document provides the most recent authoritative values for that month under the task's precedence rule. The report does not extend beyond September 2022.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). It contributes seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) data for total building permits and total housing starts covering the August through October 2022 segment of the task's required 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. Tables 1a and 3a provide the monthly SAAR totals necessary to identify months where permit rates decreased month-over-month; specifically, this report identifies October 2022 as a month where permits decreased from the revised September 2022 rate (1,564,000 to 1,526,000). It supplies the corresponding total starts rates (September: 1,488,000; October: 1,425,000) needed to calculate the change in starts for this specific qualifying month. The document does not extend to the 2023–2025 range, leaving a significant gap for the remainder of the task period.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for December 2022, issued January 19, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total building permits and total housing starts for the entire year of 2022 in Tables 1a and 3a, covering the August 2022 to December 2022 portion of the task's timeframe. It specifically records a decrease in total permits from the revised November 2022 rate to the December 2022 rate (-1.6%), identifying December 2022 as a qualifying month for the condition. The document supplies the corresponding housing starts SAAR figures (November 1,401,000; December 1,382,000) to determine the change in starts for this month. Additionally, the historical tables allow for the identification of other permit decreases in the 2022 window (e.g., October and November). Notably, the November 2022 figures are marked as revised, satisfying the task's requirement to use the most recent report values for that period. The document does not contain data for 2023 through May 2025.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for January 2023 (released February 16, 2023). It shows that permits increased from the revised December 2022 rate (1,337,000) to January 2023 (1,339,000), meaning January 2023 does not meet the permit decrease condition for the average calculation. The report includes a notice of methodology change for the Building Permits survey, which is relevant to data consistency and precedence rules, and notes that values are subject to revision in subsequent releases.
